rules.rule: Claims and values must be traceable to supplied profile evidence; unsupported values are omitted.
Select only lenses compatible with the profiled grain, measures, dimensions, and keys.
Select a compatible macrostructure before rotation; do not repeat the rotated prior choice when another compatible choice exists.
Select a compatible theme before rotation; do not repeat the rotated prior choice when another compatible choice exists.
Every insight states its evidence fields and its limitations or uncertainty.
Every chart has an accessible table twin.
Every chart has help explaining measure, basis, and interaction.
Generated reports make no network requests and contain no external runtime dependency.
Each report records a minimal evidence-appropriate external tool strategy and its integration boundary.
Each chart explicitly states whether motion is enabled and why.
The report defines one restrained reading sequence before chart-level motion is assigned.
Motion has a deterministic final state.
Reduced-motion preference disables nonessential motion while preserving final content.
Final output remains usable at narrow and wide viewports.
Final output has a legible dark-mode treatment.
Validate generated output, chart/table/help twins, motion, and zero-network before delivery.
